questions.answer: It wasnt too bad but Danes and Czechs are VERY different which is more of an acceptance than adjustment thing.

questions.answer: Tinder

questions.answer: The racism/offensive humor and people are just not very cheery - I did have the sense that people really didnt like "tourists"

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The beer and party culture to be honest
